'''Swoop''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who led [[Group Two/Legends|Group Two]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].

==Biography==
After [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] seized control of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and its [[Twi'lek/Legends|inhabitants]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to destroy the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] blockade surrounding the planet, under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

Tano led a squadron, for the first time, taking command of [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] under the callsign [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]. Swoop joined fellow pilots [[Axe (clone trooper)/Legends|Axe]], [[Slammer/Legends|Slammer]], [[Kickback/Legends|Kickback]], and [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]] in<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> his<ref name="tcwce" /> [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] in fighting the advancing [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], and his squadron was able to cut a clear path to the [[Procurer|lead ship]]. However, after Separatists reinforcements arrived out of [[hyperspace]], Tano disobeyed a direct order from both [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Yularen]] and Skywalker to return and defend the ''[[Resolute/Legends|Resolute]]''. [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]] was shot down by a Vulture droid. Ahsoka finally complied, but by the time she returned to the ''Resolute'', eight of her original ten [[Clone trooper pilot|clone pilots]] had died with Swoop and Kickback being the only survivors.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />
